d:
Watch Harris Jayaraj's Idhayathai Yedho Ondru which is an adrenaline rushing melody featuring Ajith Kumar and Anushka. The song brings out the emotions of a longing heart, with Thamarai's lyrics feature the longing feel of a lover.
Song Name - Idhayathai Yedho Ondru
Movie - Yennai Arindhaal
Singer - Chinmayi
Music - Harris Jayaraj
Lyrics - Thamarai
Director - Gautham Vasudev Menon
Starring - Ajith Kumar, Anushka Shetty
